change_summary: Treat a typed same-operation recovery action as a bounded one-shot resume invitation when the unfinished slice remains authorized and no user, permission, disclosure, or external blocker is missing.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill and API reference make the operation receipt the primary recovery authority while preserving explicit user, permission, disclosure, and external blockers.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-17.2 allows one receipt-authorized same-operation resume even when a direct source read is unavailable, without moving semantic planning into Runtime.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.61; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI versions are unchanged and remain compatible with contract 2026-09-17.2.

help_center.note: Public MCP guidance explains receipt-first one-shot recovery and the external-authority stop boundary.

package_setup.note: README, Codex defaults, and SessionStart carry the compact receipt-first recovery boundary without asking the Host to design the Tree.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records the released-host recovery miss, makes the typed receipt authoritative for one bounded retry, and keeps Runtime as typed execution and receipt owner.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Source guards, typed recovery receipts and the 30-turn ambient Work Model portfolio cover causal intake, topology and one-shot recovery; fresh released-host and Claude readback remain live gates.
